newsitem.title: UK: All three Brent dates kept before deadline - trade.
newsitem.headline: All three Brent dates kept before deadline - trade.

text.p: Of the three June 3-5 loading Brent crude cargoes in Monday's chains one was kept by J Aron, one by the Shell system and the third by Koch, traders said on Monday.
The cargo which was kept by Aron, was later sold on for a strong July Brent -20 cents, they said.

Earlier traders said that one of the cargoes subject to five o' clocking on Friday was to be defered to Monday's dates, but this did not transpire and the cargo was expected to be seen passing through Tuesday's paper chains.
